# Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning

**Authors:** Oriol Vinyals, Igor Babuschkin, Wojciech M. Czarnecki, Michaël Mathieu, Andrew Dudzik, Junyoung Chung, David H. Choi, et al.  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** Nature  
**DOI:** [10.1038/s41586-019-1724-z](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-019-1724-z)

**Keywords:** multi-agent rl, starcraft, alphastar

## Abstract

We introduce StarCraft II as a benchmark for multi-agent reinforcement learning and present AlphaStar which grandmaster-level.
